newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Golf-Woods picks up two shots on leader Parsons.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Golf-Woods picks up two shots on leader Parsons.

text.p: American Tiger Woods has picked up two shots in his second round to trail overnight leader Lucas Parsons by two strokes at the Australian Masters at Huntingdale.
Woods, the overwhelming tournament favourite, is seven under the card after seven holes.
Australian Parsons, who has yet to tee off, still leads the tournament on nine under par after equalling the course record with a brilliant 64 on Thursday.
Compatriot Peter O'Malley is a further shot back on eight under after his first round 65.
Woods shares third place on the leaderboard with Australian Brett Partridge and Canadian Rick Gibson.
